body:
Source: GitHub issue #811 (bug, security, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ de8a130a. plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs resolves the active ticket at :493 (`resolveActiveTicketIdCanonical({ root: process.cwd(), env })`), loads the store at :538 and re-resolves at :548 with `root: process.cwd()`, and `normalizePath` (:512-519) anchors on `process.cwd()` — all BEFORE the stdin payload is parsed at :563-571. plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs does the same at :77 and in main() at :477-478 (`existsSync('.adlc')`, `ticketStoreExists(process.cwd(), …)`) and :486. Copilot's preToolUse stdin carries `cwd` (docs/integrations/copilot-probe-appendix.md §2.1: `{ sessionId, timestamp, cwd, toolName, toolArgs }`), and the advisory sibling adlc-lifecycle.mjs:375 already uses `resolve(payload.cwd ?? process.cwd())`. Repro: run adlc-rails-guard.mjs with cwd = any directory without `.adlc/` and a payload whose `cwd` is a repo whose active ticket rails `test/**`, toolName `edit`, toolArgs targeting `test/x.mjs`: the hook prints `P4 rail hook inactive: no current ticket selected` to stderr, empty stdout, exit 0 — an allow of a frozen-rail edit for the whole session.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Plugin `plugins/adlc-copilot`: hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs (enforcing; deny = exit 0 + `{"reason"}` on stdout via `emitDeny`/`fail`, allow = exit 0 + empty stdout, NEVER a non-zero exit — Copilot fails open on a crashed hook; process-level uncaughtException/unhandledRejection handlers already deny), hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs (enforcing, same deny shape, inert on Copilot 1.0.73 but must read the right store), hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs (advisory, already payload-cwd aware — the reference implementation), hooks/generated-*.mjs (GENERATED copies of packages/tickets code — never hand-edit), hooks/hooks.json, test/rails-guard-contract.test.mjs (pins the deny/allow SHAPE; its fixture passes `cwd: root` in the payload AND spawns with `cwd: root`), hooks/test/helpers/run-hook.mjs (bounded spawnHook/runHook — use it), hooks/test/copilot-io-contract.test.mjs. Hooks are self-contained (no runtime deps beyond the generated copies), so the helper is defined inline in each hook, not imported from a package. Tests: `npm test -w plugins/adlc-copilot` (= `node --test test/*.test.mjs hooks/test/*.test.mjs`); root runner segments `copilot contract` and `copilot hooks`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Both enforcing hooks parse stdin FIRST and derive ONE root: `root = typeof payload.cwd === 'string' && payload.cwd.trim() !== '' ? resolve(payload.cwd) : process.cwd()`. The derivation is a small pure function with the same name in both hooks, `payloadRoot(payload, fallback)`, that never reads `process.cwd()` itself (the caller passes it as `fallback`). In adlc-rails-guard.mjs the stdin read + JSON parse + `normalizeCopilotPayload` move above the `ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT` handling and ticket resolution (the malformed-JSON `fail` stays). In adlc-build-gate.mjs `stdinJson()` is awaited before the `.adlc` existence check, and both existence checks use `root`.
2. Every `process.cwd()` that names the repository — pointer resolution, store load, `resolveActiveTicketAgainst`, `ticketStoreExists`, `existsSync('.adlc')`, the `projectRoot` and default `baseCwd` in `normalizePath`, and the shell `workdir` base — becomes `root`. `process.cwd()` remains only as the fallback passed to `payloadRoot`.
3. When the derived root differs from `process.cwd()` (after `safeRealpath` on both), print ONE stderr notice `adlc-rails-guard: resolving the repository from the payload cwd <root> (process cwd <pwd>)` (build-gate: same text with its own prefix). Nothing on stdout — stdout is the decision channel.
4. Deny/allow shape is unchanged: exit 0 always; deny is the JSON object; allow is empty stdout. A payload with no `cwd`, or a non-string `cwd`, behaves exactly as today (process.cwd()).
5. Documentation: `plugins/adlc-copilot/README.md` (the preToolUse rails-guard paragraph at ~line 32) and by hand `docs/integrations/copilot.md` (the Hook stdin bullet at ~line 170): state that the enforcing hooks resolve the repository from the payload's `cwd` and fall back to the process cwd only when the payload carries none. Never regenerate either.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 rails-guard spawned with `cwd` = an empty temp dir (no `.adlc/`) and payload `cwd` = a fixture repo with an active railed ticket, toolName `edit` on a rail path → stdout is a JSON object with `reason` naming the rail, exit 0. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/payload-cwd-root.test.mjs`
- AC2 Same spawn with a NON-rail path → empty stdout, exit 0 (allow), proving the store was read from the payload cwd rather than the hook denying for lack of one. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/payload-cwd-root.test.mjs`
- AC3 Payload WITHOUT `cwd`, spawned inside the fixture repo → identical outcomes to today (rail edit denied, non-rail allowed); payload with `cwd: 42` → treated as absent. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/payload-cwd-root.test.mjs`
- AC4 The stderr notice appears exactly once when payload cwd differs from process cwd and not at all when they match. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/payload-cwd-root.test.mjs`
- AC5 build-gate spawned outside the repo with payload `cwd` = a fixture whose pointer names a ticket absent from the store → deny JSON mentioning the active ticket (it read the payload-cwd store), exit 0; spawned outside the repo with payload `cwd` = a dir with no `.adlc` → allow. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/payload-cwd-root.test.mjs`
- AC6 `payloadRoot` is pure: given `{cwd:'/x'}` and fallback '/y' returns resolve('/x'); given `{}` returns '/y'; given `{cwd:''}` returns '/y'. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/payload-cwd-root.test.mjs`
- AC7 Existing suite green, including test/rails-guard-contract.test.mjs and hooks/test/copilot-io-contract.test.mjs untouched. verify: `npm test -w plugins/adlc-copilot`
- AC8 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c "payload" plugins/adlc-copilot/README.md docs/integrations/copilot.md` (each >= 1 on the new sentence; quote it in the PR body)
- AC9 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: adlc-lifecycle.mjs (already correct), the generated-*.mjs copies, hooks.json, the MCP server, a Copilot minimum-version pin in plugin.json, and #813 (unshipped interrogation docs).
title: adlc-copilot: enforcing hooks resolve the repository root from the payload cwd, not process.cwd()
